sources.name: PubMed
sources.purpose: Candidate literature metadata, PMIDs, publication dates, and source URLs.
sources.licenseNote: Public metadata only; do not copy protected full text.
sources.rateLimit: NCBI policy; use email/API key when available.

sources.name: Europe PMC
sources.accessMethod: REST metadata API via build-time script
sources.licenseNote: Metadata and legal OA status only unless source license explicitly permits more.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.purpose: DOI, venue, open-access, and citation metadata discovery.
sources.accessMethod: REST metadata API via build-time script
sources.licenseNote: Use metadata and OA license flags; do not store full text.

sources.name: Unpaywall
sources.purpose: Legal open-access location and license metadata.
sources.accessMethod: REST metadata API via build-time script
sources.licenseNote: OA metadata only; full text is not copied into the repo.

sources.name: CPIC Data
sources.purpose: Gene-drug guideline, recommendation, test-alert, allele, and publication coverage auditing.
sources.accessMethod: Build-time script. Check mode generates local coverage candidates; fetch mode caches CPIC API source objects.
sources.licenseNote: Source-specific CPIC usage terms; staged only until reviewed.
sources.rateLimit: Build-time only; no browser runtime calls.

sources.name: ClinPGx
sources.purpose: Guideline annotations, clinical annotations, labels, pathways, genes, chemicals, and variant context.
sources.accessMethod: Build-time script. Check mode uses ClinPGx/Open Targets derived context; fetch mode caches direct ClinPGx REST JSON.
sources.licenseNote: CC BY-SA 4.0 data usage; attribution and review required.
sources.rateLimit: 2 requests/second; scripts use >=550 ms spacing and 429 backoff.

sources.name: FDA/DailyMed Labels
sources.purpose: Public medication-label metadata and label-context review prompts for source-linked pending-review label context.
sources.accessMethod: Build-time script. Check mode initializes the lane; fetch mode uses DailyMed v2 public metadata endpoints and stores identifiers/metadata only.
sources.licenseNote: Use public label metadata and source identifiers only until reviewed; do not copy protected label content beyond allowed excerpts.
sources.rateLimit: Build-time only; no browser runtime calls.

sources.name: DailyMed
sources.purpose: DailyMed v2 public label metadata records used as source-linked pending-review label context.
sources.accessMethod: Build-time script using DailyMed v2 public metadata endpoints only.
sources.licenseNote: Public metadata and identifiers only; do not store label body text, tables, figures, or copied warning passages.
sources.rateLimit: Build-time only; no browser runtime calls.

sources.name: PharmCAT output
sources.purpose: Future session-only phenotype/diplotype/report imports from user-provided PGx files.
sources.accessMethod: User/session import; not a global enrichment source
sources.licenseNote: User-supplied output; do not mutate shipped database files.

sources.name: Open Targets
sources.purpose: Offline ChEMBL/Open Targets context, pharmacovigilance, ClinPGx, and target-safety review prompts.
sources.licenseNote: Dataset-specific Open Targets context; not severity-bearing unless reviewed.

sources.name: Manual human review
sources.purpose: Reviewer decisions that can promote staged records into curated Diognosis source files.
sources.licenseNote: Reviewer must verify source faithfulness, copyright, mapping, and clinical wording.

sources.name: Internal Diognosis curated data
sources.purpose: Current DRUG_DB, KNOWN_DDI, METAB, PGx, PK, timing, and STUDY_DB coverage.
sources.licenseNote: Project-curated source-linked prototype data; public evidence remains pending review.
